_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session Y2: plan exposure_1 on the YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B pair, one model per card. Y1 (2026-09-27/28) found the pair naming ОКВЭД 2 codes by feature completion (32 and 28 of 250 against a 3.4% baseline) and not naming МКБ-10 (reports/RESULTS_EXPOSURE.md Part IV). exposure_1 adds the row-completion side of the same two classifiers, scored with the distance bins frozen in src/classifier_diagnostics.py, plus header and row on cardio_train, alice_train_sessions and the Moscow metro export; with it the H2e family of the pair is complete and gets its Holm verdict. iris anchors the plan: 76/142 for the pretrain model and 53/142 for the instruct model in both Y1 plans. The runner enforces transformers 5.14.1 and SentencePiece and tests the tokenizer on a probe string; the results files must now carry the round-trip report under load.tokenizer.
attached_input: the nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached as one Kaggle dataset (loose or zipped); the fetch step adopts them from /kaggle/input, looks inside zips, and verifies every hash before any weights load

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: the pretrain model; 5.7 h by src/price_plan.py with its own tokenizer, which priced Y1 exactly; 7.7 h at the worst overrun seen (35%)
its instruct model, same cells, same seed, the other card. Needs the T4 x2 accelerator; ru_probe (6.1 h) is not added because the two plans together exceed the 10 h session ceiling of AMENDMENT_9 §7
